intent: Refine approved 3A materials and restore right-side out-in-out silhouette
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise-object-edit / material refinement.
Deliver ONE revised full landscape 16:9 screenshot of layout 3A of Chinese Cthulhu card game 《邪神的宝藏》. High fidelity functional UI mockup.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the approved layout-3A screenshot. Retain its game information, large dark fan of five player cards, left self plaque and faith banner, four top opponent panels, turn display and dial, right log and close RIGHT-side vertical button stack.
Image 2 is the AUTHORITATIVE MATERIAL / PAINTING / SILHOUETTE reference, the original seaside screenshot. Match its coarse realistic dark painting, sea-gray low saturation palette, aged irregularly lit metal, deep black worn cloth, fog and atmospheric integration.
Image 3 is the ACTUAL IN-GAME derived-card reference. Its lower-right "黑山羊幼仔" card shows the correct eldritch black goat artwork and frame. Use that sinister textured artwork ONLY for tiny face-up derived cards in the top opponent mini-hands; do not use cute big-eyed goats.
Image 4 is the ACTUAL IN-GAME player-hand appearance reference. Preserve the approved five dark card faces, fine borders, 392:590 width:height and existing content. Do not redesign or restyle these card faces. Do NOT import the green arc table, layout or corner props from image 4.

USER REQUEST: 3A is best, but its UI pieces are too cartoon-like, and the original right side's OUT–IN–OUT edge contour has been flattened / reversed. Change the material rendering and right silhouette substantially enough to see the improvement, while preserving the approved layout and rules. This is a targeted revision, not a new interface theme.

PRIORITY 1 — RESTORE THE RIGHT OUTLINE:
The leftmost edge of the ROUND PLAQUE must protrude furthest LEFT, around x=74% of canvas width. Keep it connected to the occult dial at the top-right corner. The aged metal left corner may reach x=72.5%; its body begins 74%.
The LOG beneath it must be conspicuously RECESSED TO THE RIGHT: left fabric edge around x=85–86%, flush near the right side, wrapped ivory log text within the narrower cloth. Its left edge follows a naturally hanging cloth with slight irregularity and believable folds, no bright continuous outline, no rectangular rigid sidebar. Keep five actual log messages visible by wrapping rather than truncating. Finished worn pointed hem, no gradient fade.
The FOUR BUTTONS beneath the log must PROTRUDE LEFT AGAIN, around x=77–78%, clearly left of the log but still not as far left as the top round plaque. All remain entirely to the RIGHT of the cards, closely adjacent to the last card, in the same compact vertical stack as 3A: "掉包", "休息", "繁衍", "结束回合". Keep all four frames identical reusable shape and size. The same foreground tentacle / desk supports their back edges, allowing them to jut out into the sea silhouette. No monolithic panel connecting all three widths.
Thus viewing the right edge as a silhouette, it has a prominent upper ledge, a deep middle recess, and a lower ledge. THE TOP ROUND PLAQUE IS THE FURTHEST-LEFT UI PART OF THIS RIGHT ASSEMBLY. Do not align turn/log/buttons to one vertical edge.
To accommodate the wider left reach of the round plaque without overlap, compact the group of four top opponent panels horizontally about 15%, keeping them identical and upright, spanning approximately x=25% to 72%. Each still visibly includes portrait, name, both HP/SAN bars and its tiny hand strip. Do not overlap the round plaque with a character panel.
Preserve the large card fan almost unchanged. If necessary move it only slightly right to keep a small comfortable gap to the button column; no card/button overlap.
Remove the current thick rectangular prompt cap. Put "你的回合 · 请选择行动" on a short dark woven cloth tab directly above the button column, inset 8–10% from each side of the buttons and attached with two small dull metal pins. It is thin, flexible and subdued, NOT a fifth same-width framed button. It belongs to the lower protruding cluster; do not stretch it across the recessed log gap.

PRIORITY 2 — REPLACE TOY-LIKE UI MATERIALS WITH THE ORIGINAL'S PHYSICAL REALISM:
- All NON-CARD frames: reduce thick decorative bevel / uniform bright gold double-outline weight by about one third. Use narrow blackened bronze skeletons, chipped rubbed edges, irregular oxidation, tiny dark crevices and fine shallow engraving. Highlights appear only on light-facing corners and a few worn spots; most of the perimeter is shadowed. No evenly glowing bright outline, smooth plastic, jewel candy, polished gold or layered cookie-cutter frame.
- Button face material is almost-black aged cloth or distressed leather, subtle weave / scratches / stains, with low-saturation color stains: muted blue-green for 掉包, old brown-amber for 休息, gray-plum for unavailable 繁衍, restrained dark iron-red for 结束回合. Color occupies the MATERIAL rather than a flat solid fill. Keep buttons prominent through shape, readable text and localized metal highlights rather than neon. No cartoon glossy mobile-game buttons.
- Button symbols are 15% smaller: shallow worn bone/silver engraved emblems with fine internal scratches, not bold flat vector/emoji silhouettes. Use a small two-card exchange emblem for 掉包, a modest rest/bed emblem for 休息, a fine organic branching emblem for 繁衍, an old hourglass for 结束回合. Text remains clear warm ivory, not pure-white glowing.
- Other players' portraits: weathered realistic painterly faces like image 2, natural proportions, subtle skin texture, reduced smooth forehead/cheek specular highlights, no sculpted 3D toy heads or comic ink outlines. Preserve the four names and all info. Derived cards use real sinister artwork from image 3, no adorable animal mascots.
- HP/SAN bars retain readable color and numeric values, but use thin worn metal channels rather than shiny pill-shaped plastic capsules. Self "HP 8/10", "SAN 6/10". Each SAN track retains the fixed 60% tick labeled "6". Opponents keep "HP 7/10, SAN 8/10", "HP 9/10, SAN 5/10", "HP 6/10, SAN 7/10", "HP 8/10, SAN 9/10". Do not drop these bars.
- Faith cloth is real dark weathered woven fabric with creases and edge fraying. Preserve current belief, effect and tags; no new decorative poem. All other UI emblems and hand count medal have the same subdued aged material, not bright gold stickers.
- Scene light must also illuminate UI: cold sea rim light on upper/right-facing surfaces, faint warm candle reflection on lower/left-facing metal, small contact shadows where cloth and frames meet the environment. Preserve text readability. Do NOT merely darken the entire screenshot; correct texture and highlight behavior.
- Keep background camera, ruins, distant Cthulhu, sea, skull/candles and foreground desk from image 1, in image 2's muted realistic treatment. No extra graphic decoration or more ornate flourishes to solve the problem.

LOCKED INVARIANTS:
No change to game rules or list of functional regions. No new card-face design, no bright parchment card panels, no big round cost icons. Five player card fronts remain rigid rectangles 392:590, consistent overlap, mild fan rotation only, fully inside frame; no clipping or stretched cards, no labels below them. Opponent panels all the same reusable shape, no trapezoids / tilt / shear. Secret mini-hand cards stay face-down; only the actual black-goat-young derived cards face up. All four actions stay right of the player hand. Keep HP/SAN bar form, SAN=6 ticks, faith/tags cloth, turn, log, hand badge and supply counts. No thick horizontal upper/lower divider. No outside annotations, comparison labels, watermark or contact sheet.
